Runtime and base image

The container image runs Sammlarr on the .NET runtime and ASP.NET Core, licensed under MIT,
Copyright (c) .NET Foundation and Contributors. Their licence and Microsoft's third-party notices ship in the image at
/usr/share/dotnet/LICENSE.txt and /usr/share/dotnet/ThirdPartyNotices.txt.

The base image is mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet (Ubuntu, chiseled). Its operating system packages are separate
programs under their own licences, some of them copyleft. Every release lists them with their versions and licences in
the image SBOM (sammlarr-image.cdx.json), and each package keeps its copyright file in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright
in the image. Their source is published by Ubuntu at https://launchpad.net/ubuntu (apt-get source <package>).
